penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Building an ERP suite (accounting, HR, payroll, sales) is a massive multi-year software engineering effort; delivery cannot be automated by Claude.

rationale: The buyer is poorly defined — 'SMB owners and developers evaluating open-source ERP' is a diffuse group, many of whom specifically want free open-source software and are not paying customers. Building even a minimal ERP suite (accounting, payroll, sales) is a multi-year engineering project orders of magnitude beyond this factory's tooling. Willingness to pay is low because the explicit ask is for open-source alternatives. Total after penalties is 1.6 — drop immediately.
solution_plan: This is not viable for this factory. An ERP or business application suite is one of the most complex categories of software that exists; it cannot be built with Claude prompts and a landing page. The buyers are primarily seeking free open-source tools, not paying for a service. Drop entirely.
notes: buildability_with_ai (2), operational_autonomy (2), buyer_clarity (3), willingness_to_pay (3) all fail build gates. Total after penalties is 1.6 — drop.
